What the record says

  • The Dolphins' best spread spot with at least 30 graded games is home underdog (all time): 76-64-2 against the spread, a 54.3% cover rate.
  • Their weakest is favored by 3.5 to 6.5 (since 2002): 22-30, 42.3%.
